name: ybar
title: YBar
description: Change how your YBar status bar looks: the knobs the running theme declares, theme switching, widget order, all from Raycast.
author: aegiosot

commands.name: settings
commands.title: YBar Settings
commands.subtitle: YBar
commands.description: Edit the settings the running theme declares. Untouched rows follow the theme.

commands.name: themes
commands.title: YBar Themes
commands.subtitle: YBar
commands.description: List the themes YBar can switch to and pick one; the bar reloads in place.

commands.name: widgets
commands.title: YBar Widgets
commands.subtitle: YBar
commands.description: Turn the bar's widgets on or off and reorder them.

commands.name: reload
commands.title: Reload YBar
commands.subtitle: YBar
commands.description: Re-run the bar's config in place.

preferences.name: socketPath
preferences.title: Socket path
preferences.description: Where the running bar listens. Leave empty for the default, /tmp/ybar_<user>.socket.
